body:
Implements ADR-016 (docs/decisions/016-inline-formatting.md).

## Summary

Inline elements currently render as blocks. A p with a nested em is three stacked blocks instead of one flowing line. Additionally, the RTL heuristic from ADR-015 diverges from Firefox for mixed-direction paragraphs; dir attribute support resolves it.

Three coordinated changes: display property, inline formatting context, dir attribute.

## Scope

### Change 1: Display property

Add Display enum: Block, Inline, None.

Read from ComputedStyle::get("display"). Default Block when missing.

UA stylesheet additions: 19 elements get display: inline.

### Change 2: Inline node types

LayoutKind gains Inline and InlineContext.

New LayoutInline: element pointer, children, style fields (font_family, font_size, color).

New LayoutInlineContext: children (inline items), lines (LineFragments), rtl flag.

LineFragment gains style fields: font_family, font_size, color.

### Change 3: Inline context construction

Block container collects inline children into LayoutInlineContext.

Flatten inline tree depth-first into (text, style) items.

Line breaking across the whole sequence, not per text node.

Per-word style carried through to LineFragment.

### Change 4: Direction resolution

resolve_direction(el, parent, text) -> Direction:
- dir=ltr -> LTR
- dir=rtl -> RTL
- dir=auto -> first-strong heuristic
- missing -> inherit from parent (default LTR at html)

Applied per block container. Resolves ADR-015 divergence.

### Change 5: Paint per-fragment style

draw_line_with_pango uses fragment's own font_family, font_size, color.

LayoutInline is structural, not painted directly.

### Change 6: Tests

test_layout.cpp: inline flow, mixed inline/block, dir resolution.

test_paint.cpp: per-fragment style painting.

test_ua_stylesheet.cpp: 19 display: inline rules.

## Behavior (before / after)

p with nested em -> 1 line (was 3 stacked blocks)
p with nested em, narrow container -> 2 lines (was 3 stacked blocks)
p dir=ltr with Arabic -> left-aligned (was right-aligned)
html dir=rtl with Arabic -> right-aligned (inherited)
p dir=auto with Arabic -> right-aligned (opt-in)

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Display enum + reading from ComputedStyle
- [ ] LayoutInline + LayoutInlineContext node types
- [ ] LineFragment has font_family, font_size, color
- [ ] Inline children collected into LayoutInlineContext
- [ ] Inline tree flattened depth-first for line breaking
- [ ] Per-word style in line breaking
- [ ] dir attribute resolved per block container
- [ ] dir=auto uses first-strong heuristic
- [ ] missing dir inherits from parent
- [ ] Paint uses fragment's style, not parent's
- [ ] 19 display: inline rules in UA stylesheet
- [ ] All existing 190 tests pass
- [ ] New tests: 12+ layout, 2+ paint, 2+ ua_stylesheet
- [ ] grep -rl "lexbor/" src/ returns only src/renderer/html/convert.cpp
- [ ] CI green

## Multi-commit plan

- Commit 1: Display enum + reading + LayoutInline/LayoutInlineContext types + LineFragment style fields (no behavior change)
- Commit 2: Inline context construction + flattening + per-word style in line breaking + tests
- Commit 3: dir attribute resolution + tests
- Commit 4: Paint per-fragment style + tests
- Commit 5: UA stylesheet display: inline rules + tests
- Commit 6: docs refresh

Each commit builds and passes tests. Same rhythm as ADR-015.

## Deferred (per ADR-016)

display none/flex/grid/table, baseline alignment, direction CSS property, full UAX #9 bidi, inline across block boundaries, vertical-align, line-height, float, position.

## Refs

- ADR-016: docs/decisions/016-inline-formatting.md
- ADR-015: docs/decisions/015-text-wrapping.md
- ADR-011: docs/decisions/011-first-paint.md
title: [Help Wanted]: Implement inline formatting, display, and dir attribute per ADR-016
